Plan: labels outside the plots and a tidier UI (issues #12 and #19)¶

Branch: 19-ui-cleanup, from main at 328f5be. Status: steps 1–10 implemented (2026-10-20), PR #26. The user tested the GUI on screen (2026-10-20).

1. Goal¶

Issue #12: move the labels that are drawn inside the plots to just outside them, and give the plots more white space, so the data is easier to see.

Issue #19: the UI has become cluttered.

  • Replace many of the buttons with drop-down menu items.

  • Keep the plots readable when the window is small.

  • Group related controls so that they are easier to find.

Both issues change the same code (src/app/app.cpp, src/app/app_live.cpp and the plot helpers), so this plan covers them together.

2. Starting point (main)¶

Screenshots taken with --screenshot on Xvfb, at 1600×950 and 1100×700, in file mode (simulator recording, channel at +400 kHz) and in live mode (--device sim).

Inside the plots (#12):

Spacing and clipping (#12):

  • PlotPadding is 18×6 px. The last X tick label is cut off at the right edge (“520 ms”, “101.2 MI” in live mode).

  • The colour bar is a fixed 4.5 em wide, so “-100 dB” shows as “-100 d”.

  • At 700 px of height the spectrum plot is about 70 px tall: its five dB tick labels touch each other.

Clutter (#19):

  • File mode has three toolbar rows above the plots, with about 40 controls: the 4 window buttons, the file fields, 9 navigation buttons, span, start, sample, the bookmarks and 3 marker checkboxes. At 1100 px the toolbar wraps to five rows plus the overview strip, and takes about 210 px before the first plot.

  • The waterfall pane has 13 controls on 2–3 rows, and the channel pane has 11 controls on 2–3 rows.

  • Every time plot has its own row of controls (mode, smooth, checkboxes, Auto Y).

  • Live mode has the same pattern: the device row, the record row (prefix, format, samples, limit) and 14 spectrum controls.

  • The Signal gen, Audio and Export windows open from buttons in the first row.

3. Design¶

3.1 Labels outside the plots (#12)¶

  1. Readouts move out of the plot to the plot’s header row, right-aligned after its controls, as dim text. When the row is too narrow they wrap to the next line (the existing flow() helper) instead of covering the plot. endTimePlot no longer draws on the plot.

  2. The I/Q legend moves above the plot with ImPlotLegendFlags_Outside (North, horizontal). Clicking an entry still hides that trace. The signal generator preview gets the same treatment.

  3. The selection hint (“Drag a box to export; Esc cancels”) moves to the status bar while a selection is active. The waterfall shows only the crosshair.

  4. White space:

    • PlotPadding becomes about 10×10 px, with room on the right for the last tick label.

    • A small gap between stacked plots.

    • The colour bar width is computed from the widest label (“-100 dB”) instead of being a fixed 4.5 em.

  5. Minimum sizes: the spectrum keeps at least about 5 lines of text in height, and a time plot at least about 7. When there isn’t room, the plot stack scrolls (as it does now) instead of squashing.

3.2 Menu bar and grouped controls (#19)¶

A menu bar (ImGui’s menu bar on the main window) replaces the window buttons and the view checkboxes. Shortcuts are shown next to each item:

Menu

Items

File

Open… (puts the cursor in the path box), Export region… (Ctrl+E), Quit (Ctrl+Q)

View

Time markers (T), Freq markers (F), Relative frequency, Peak hold, I/Q / AM / FM / PM plots, Overview strip, Show everything (A)

Tools

Signal generator (Ctrl+G), Audio (Ctrl+D), Use GPU (only when a GPU is available)

Help

Keyboard shortcuts, About (version, GPU, renderer)

Status that must stay visible goes on the right of the menu bar: the source selector (File / Device), a red TX ON while transmitting, and REC while recording.

File row:

  • Kept on the row: the File path and Open, Sample rate, Center freq, Segment, and the file info.

  • Format, Header bytes, Swap I/Q and Big endian move into a format button that shows a summary (“ci16 ▾”, or “ci16 BE swap ▾”) and opens a small popup. SigMF and gqrx names set these automatically, so they are rarely edited.

Navigation row:

  • The |< << < > >> >|  + - All buttons stay, as one tight group.

  • Span (preset and value) and Start stay.

  • Sample moves into the Start field’s popup (or tooltip) as “Go to sample”.

  • Bookmark and the bookmark list become one Bookmarks ▾ combo, with “Add bookmark (B)” as its first item.

Waterfall pane:

  • One row: FFT, Window, dB min, dB max, Auto, and a ⚙ button.

  • The ⚙ button opens “Waterfall settings”: Overlap, Avg, Rows, Cols, Colormap and Peak. GPU is in the Tools menu.

  • The “FFT sees N%” warning stays on the row.

Channel pane:

  • One row: Channel, Offset, BW, To peak, ⚙, then the info text (“out 300 kSps | D=8 | …”).

  • The ⚙ button opens Taps, Decim, Squelch (with its level), Max pts and Plot H.

Each time plot:

  • The header is ☑ Name   readout …  ⚙.

  • The ⚙ button opens that plot’s options: Mode, Smooth, Degrees, Rel. to channel and Auto Y.

  • The same options are also added to the plot’s right-click menu.

Live mode follows the same pattern:

  • Device row: Device, Rescan, Center freq, Sample rate, Gain, AGC, Start/Stop, and ⚙ for the device-specific settings (Bias-T, direct sampling, antenna, bandwidth).

  • The record row shrinks to a red Record button, its status text, and ⚙ for the prefix, format, samples and limit.

  • The spectrum controls use the waterfall pattern: FFT, Window, dB range, Auto, then ⚙ for Avg, Rows/s, History, Cols, Spec avg, Colormap and Peak/reset.

Shared helpers: settingsButton(id) (a ⚙ button that opens a popup, using the beginForm/row table layout already in app_export.cpp), plus a thin vertical separator between groups on a row. The duplicated tooltipAlways/row/beginForm helpers in four files move into ui_util.

3.3 Small windows¶

  • Fewer controls means fewer wrapped rows. The target is 2 rows above the overview at 1100 px wide, against 5 now.

  • The overview strip can be hidden from the View menu. It hides by itself when the window is shorter than about 600 px.

  • The left/right split keeps a minimum width for each side that fits one row of its controls.

  • The status bar shortens long paths in the middle (/private/…/sim_…sigmf-data), so the GPU/fps text on the right is no longer covered (it is covered now at 1100 px).

3.4 Not changed¶

  • Keyboard shortcuts, command-line options, mouse actions (Ctrl+click, Shift+click, right-drag zoom, the waterfall right-click menu) and the floating windows.

  • The contents of the Signal gen, Audio and Export windows. Only their legends and spacing change.

  • Settings are still not saved between runs (NoSavedSettings). This could be a later issue.

4. Implementation steps¶

  1. Helpers. Move tooltipAlways, row and beginForm into ui_util, and add settingsButton and a group separator. No visible change.

  2. #12, readouts and legends. Readouts go on the header rows; I/Q and preview legends go outside; the selection hint goes to the status bar.

  3. #12, spacing. Plot padding, the colour bar width, minimum plot heights and the gap between plots.

  4. #19, menu bar. File/View/Tools/Help, the source selector, and the TX/REC indicators. Remove the window buttons and the view checkboxes from the toolbar.

  5. #19, file and navigation rows. The format popup, Bookmarks ▾, and the sample field moved under Start.

  6. #19, the waterfall and channel panes. One row each, plus ⚙ popups.

  7. #19, the time plots. ☑ Name  readout  ⚙ headers and the right-click options.

  8. #19, live mode. The device, record and spectrum rows.

  9. Small windows. Hiding the overview, the minimum widths of the split and the shortened status path.

  10. Docs. Update the README GUI section (the menu bar, where each setting moved) and add implementation notes to this plan.

5. Testing¶

  • Screenshots (--screenshot, Xvfb over TCP) at 1600×950, 1280×800, 1100×700 and 900×600, in file mode with the channel on and in live mode with --device sim, before and after each step. A small script in the scratchpad takes the whole set.

  • Check by eye:

    • nothing is drawn over the data, apart from the markers, the channel band and the hover lines;

    • no tick labels are cut off;

    • each pane fits on one row at 1600 px.

  • Self-tests: all of them still pass. They don’t touch the GUI, but app.cpp builds into the same targets.

  • The CLI options that drive the GUI still work: --chan, --view, --segment, --siggen, --gen, --export-window and --device.

  • On screen (user): menus and shortcuts, the ⚙ popups, legend click-to-hide, the region selection hint, and resizing the window down to about 900×600.

6. Decisions needed¶

  1. One branch or two? Recommended: one branch, 19-ui-cleanup, closing both issues with separate commits. The readouts from #12 go into the plot headers that #19 rebuilds, so doing #12 alone first would mean redoing those headers.

  2. A menu bar or a single ☰ button? Recommended: a menu bar. It costs one row but removes the window buttons and the checkboxes, and the shortcuts become easy to find.

  3. Sample rate and center freq: keep them on the file row (recommended, since they are often typed for raw files), or move them into the format popup?

  4. Time plot options: a ⚙ popup and the right-click menu (recommended), or only one of the two?

  5. Readouts: right-aligned on the header row (recommended), or on a line under each plot?

  6. Sample field: move it under Start (recommended) or keep it on the row?

7. Decisions (2026-10-20)¶

The user chose the recommendations: one branch (19-ui-cleanup) for both issues, a menu bar, sample rate and center frequency kept on the file row, time-plot options behind ⚙ and on the right-click, readouts on the header rows, and the sample field moved off the row.

The loop ends on File → Quit / Ctrl+Q

README.md

Screen layout, mouse and keyboard, and the places that named the old buttons

Differences from the plan¶

  • Sample field: it went into a Go to drop-down together with Add bookmark and the bookmarks (one control instead of three). The Start field’s tooltip shows the sample index.

  • Header layout: ☑ Name ⚙ readout — the ⚙ sits right after the name, so it does not move when the readout changes length or wraps.

  • Right-click on a time plot now opens wvt’s options popup instead of ImPlot’s own plot menu (ImPlotFlags_NoMenus, as on the waterfall). Double-click still fits; right-drag still zooms.

  • dB min / max lost their −/+ step buttons to fit on one row; type the value, or use Auto.

  • Peak hold is in View and in the waterfall / live ⚙ options. Use the GPU moved to Tools.

  • Group separators: not added; the rows keep the wider flow gap between groups, which reads clearly once each row has fewer controls.

  • Minimum split widths were not added: with fewer controls, each pane wraps to at most two rows at 900 px.

  • The live record row joined the device row (it wraps when there is no room).

Verification (macOS)¶

  • Screenshots on Xvfb (TCP display, --software) at 1600×950, 1280×800, 1100×700 and 900×600, file and live mode: no readout or legend over the traces, no cut-off tick labels, the colour bar shows “-100 dB” in full.

  • Menus and popups opened with XTest clicks (a ctypes script) and captured with xwd: View menu, Format drop-down, waterfall ⚙, channel ⚙, a right-click on the AM plot, Go to, Help → Keyboard and mouse, live Record ⚙. File → Quit ends the program.

  • --export-window and --gen pulsed open their windows as before.

  • All six self-tests pass.

GUI¶

The user tested the new layout on screen (2026-10-20): the menus and shortcuts, the ⚙ popups, the time-plot right-click, the legends, the region selection and resizing the window.
